title: cal memory review --json
description: `cal memory review`: what agents and memory passes did to memory that nobody reviewed: the facts agents replaced or recorded in the last 7 days, then open disputes and stale / wrong flags, each group newest first.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

results.description: The rows, best match (or newest) first.

notice.description:
Present only when `results` is empty because this machine couldn't run the query (no
embedding model for `decisions` / `gotchas`), so a reader can tell that from no match.

more.description:
How many more items there are to review than `results` lists (it stops at 50, the
replaced and recorded ones first); 0 when it lists them all.

factId.description: The fact the item is about (for `replaced`, the one that was replaced).

project.description: The fact's project key ("" when it has none).

at.description: When the reason arose (unix secs): the flag, the link, or the fact's recording.

source.description:
Who did it: `agent` or `distill` (a memory pass) for a flag, the link's source for a
dispute (`distill`, `agent`, `repo`, `review`, `user`), `agent` otherwise.

other.description: What replaced it, or what disputes it.

note.description: A flag's reason, as the agent gave it (redacted when it was stored).

trusted.description: The user pinned or edited it, so a flag leaves it in memory (when `injectable`).

injectable.description:
Injected memory can carry it: it is pinned, or neither a failure playbook nor a
subagent's fact (those stay out unless pinned, whether edited or not). False: a flag
on it, or keeping one, changes nothing an agent is shown.

ReviewItem.description:
One fact for the user to look at: something an agent (or a memory pass) did to memory that
nobody reviewed.

oneOf.description:
An agent or a memory pass flagged it stale or wrong: it is out of injected memory
until the user keeps or hides it, unless pinned or edited (`trusted`). A fact memory
never injects (`injectable` false) is not shown to agents either way.
Another fact contradicts it and nothing settled the pair: both stay injected, marked.
An agent's fact replaced it since `since`: it left injected memory with no review.

ReviewReason.description: Why a fact is on the memory review list ([`memory_review`]).

ReviewOther.description: The fact on the other side of a review item.
